# Battle Foresee Editor

Battle · Live demo & interactive props: `/cumulus#/battle-foresee-editor`

Real consumers: **2** (imports outside `src/cumulus/docs/` and tests).

A commit-gated local editor for a prepared deck prefix, count choices, deck order, and Void partition.

> **Guidance:** Supply allowed counts and battle-instance IDs; apply the emitted complete result in battle state.

Pointer capture and keyboard controls edit the same staged result without mutating input arrays.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | `BattleForeseeEditorModel` | yes | — | The exact cards inspected by the effect. |
| `onConfirm` | `(resolution: BattleForeseeResult) => void` | yes | — | Commits one complete order/void resolution. |

### `model`: the `BattleForeseeEditorModel` model

| Field | Type | Optional | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `initialCount` | `number` | no | Number of cards shown when the modal opens. |
| `cards` | `readonly BattleForeseeEditorCard[]` | no | Available cards in their original top-to-bottom deck order. |
| `allowedCounts` | `readonly number[]` | no | Closed ordered set of card counts the player may stage. |
| `source` | `DreamwellCardModel` | yes | Dreamwell card whose effect opened this authoritative prompt. |

## Usage

```tsx
<BattleForeseeEditor model={preparedForesee} onConfirm={commitResult} />
```
